name: Multi-Campus Voucher & Petty Cash Management System
description: Aplus School System Multi-Campus Voucher & Petty Cash Management System with five voucher types (Bank Payment BPV, Bank Receipt BRV, Cash Payment CPV, Cash Receipt CRV, and Journal Voucher JV), full transaction ledger, petty cash management, physical reconciliation, financial reporting, and complete 49-section system manual.
